name: Voxel Cone Tracing Global Illumination
definition: A technique for specular global illumination that utilizes voxel cone tracing, requiring only a single cone trace for glossy materials, which lowers performance cost compared to diffuse global illumination applications.
summary: Voxel Cone Tracing Global Illumination is a real-time technique that approximates indirect lighting by storing radiance in a voxel grid and sampling it via cone tracing, supporting specular reflections with lower performance costs than diffuse-only methods.
